subject: french
title: Describing Things
welcome_lead: Putting colours and adjectives to use.
meta_desc: KS3 French: describing objects with colours and adjectives.
final_note: Combine vocab to describe what you see.

walkthroughs.body_html: To say 'it is red': C'est rouge. For a specific object: il est (m) or elle est (f). 'Le livre est bleu' = the book is blue.
Colours come after: 'un stylo bleu' (a blue pen). But size adjectives go before: 'un grand livre' (a big book).
'Dans ma trousse il y a un grand stylo bleu' = 'In my pencil case there's a big blue pen'. Notice the order: number, size, item, colour.
